All 4 tests pass now, 70ms.

**Found it: `processOrder.js` was leaking connections on failed orders.**

It called `pool.acquire()` then released only after `run()` succeeded — no try/finally. Every failed order (bad payload, etc.) left its connection stuck in `inUse` forever. Your worker log shows exactly that pattern: a string of `invalid order payload` failures around 02:06, then `pool exhausted: no connections available` two calls later — the pool ran dry and the service tipped over.

The request-path code in `handlers/api.js` was already safe since it goes through `withConnection`, which does wrap in try/finally — `processOrder` just skipped that helper.

Fix: wrapped the acquire/run/release in `src/jobs/processOrder.js:6-11` with try/finally, same pattern as the safe wrapper. Nothing else needed changing.

Next: redeploy the worker with this fix — that's what was paging you.
